name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement is a -100% drop in leads and spend over the last 7 days, flagged as a zero-spend day and channel going dark on Meta, which drove the full collapse in lead volume from what had been a 28-day average of $8.58 CPL across 72 leads. With Meta accounting for 100% of the $618.04 in spend and now going silent, pipeline intake has stalled, though GBP continues to show organic engagement with 73 calls and 105 directions over the 28-day window.

performance.verdict: Meta dark 7 days; 5 overdue milestones make pipeline attribution untrustworthy.

findings.text: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 12–13, then Sep 16–18 — 5 of last 7 days dark. Leads collapsed to 0 from a 28-day CPL of $8.58.
Phone-match attribution gap overdue since Aug 7; dashboard overdue since Aug 31. 74 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — scoreboard is blind.
Renewal prove-it month and August scoreboard trust decision both overdue Aug 31. Stay/walk client decision has no trusted data to anchor it.
3-day signal (Sep 16–18): spend $0/$0/$0, leads 0/0/0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 13–15) spend $38.94/$18.49/$0 — channel dark is confirmed, not noise.
GBP organic still active (73 calls, 105 directions in 28 days) while paid is dark — organic floor holds but cannot replace lead pipeline alone.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta campaign spend immediately — 5 consecutive zero days, $0 generated vs $8.58 CPL baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend for 5 of the last 7 days (Sep 12–13 and Sep 16–18), killing all lead intake from a working $8.58 CPL baseline across 72 leads. Diagnose the pause reason (billing, policy, manual pause) and restore the BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign to its last active daily budget today. Success check: spend resumes and at least 1 lead registers within 48 hours of reactivation. Re-check Sep 22.

suggestions.text: Deliver dashboard and attribution gap fix — both overdue; 0 won opps and 0 appointments make Aug scoreboard unreadable.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap (due Aug 7) and the lead-to-patient dashboard (due Aug 31) are both undelivered. GHL shows 74 opportunities created, 0 won, and 0 appointments — the client's scoreboard (leads → schedule → show → new patient) cannot be read. Ahmed/Ali to ship attribution fix and dashboard draft to Sohib by Sep 22. Success check: Sohib can trace at least one lead to a scheduled appointment in the dashboard by Sep 24.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP call volume post Meta reactivation — 73 calls in 28 days may mask halo effect worth isolating.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP logged 73 calls and 105 directions in the 28-day window despite Meta going dark, suggesting organic holds some floor independently. Once Meta spend resumes, track whether GBP call volume rises in parallel (halo) or stays flat (independent). Re-check Oct 1 with 7-day GBP delta post-reactivation to decide if GBP deserves its own attribution line on the dashboard.
